rules.smoke_not_a_gate: the gr-* greedy identity runs are an exploratory smoke test: a PASS does not discharge Q, a divergence alone is not a quality failure, and the frozen package Q is required before any quality or serving claim. No head-only saving is headlined; the head phase is a profile reading inside the both-on arm only

mechanism.dense_extra: at >= 7 rows (the head: the window's T rows; K/V: each group's rows) the head's Q5_K projection runs iq_mmq_decode instead of native_mmvq (projection most of 3.26 ms); K and V each add an activation quantize (or a q8_1 conversion) + XMX product in place of one MMVQ on the existing q8_1 (2560 -> 512, small: about +0.03-0.1 ms a stage). At 4-6 rows the calls take the generic MMQ product (STRATA_BATCH_DENSE_MMQ_MIN=4), at 1-3 the GEMV: agent traffic (~6.5 rows a group) moves only part of its windows
mechanism.native_q8_1: each XMX dense call converts the caller's native q8_1 to planar (reads ~1.1 B an element) instead of re-quantizing fp32 (4 B an element + a block max); it drops the LEAN z reuse (z then pays one conversion launch a GDN layer) and the shared expert's down input becomes native SwiGLU + conversion (two launches for one). The launch count does not fall, so the saving is below the freeze's 0.6 ms ceiling for removing the quantize
mechanism.both: the head and K/V take the conversion instead of the quantize; the effects add
